name: Mechanical Engineer (Min)

children.name: General Minor in Mechanical Engineering
children.desc: Students interested in this minor must take the following courses as prerequisites: MATH 19/MATH 20/MATH 21 or equivalent and PHYSICS 41.

children.name: Thermosciences Minor in Mechanical Engineering
children.desc: Students interested in this minor must take the following courses as prerequisites: MATH 19/MATH 20/MATH 21 or equivalent, MATH 51 (or CME 100), and PHYSICS 41.

children.name: Mechanical Design Minor in Mechanical Engineering
children.desc:
This minor includes design activities supported by analysis and has the following courses as prerequisites: MATH 19/MATH 20/MATH 21 or equivalent, and PHYSICS 41.
Due to the number of overlapping core courses, program majors may not add the Mechanical Design Minor in Mechanical Engineering.

rules.name: Combined GPA of 2.7 for minor courses

gpa: The minimum combined Grade Point Average for all courses in the minor is 2.7.
grading: The minimum grade in each course is a C.
policies: Courses used to fulfill the requirements of other degree programs cannot be used to fulfill the requirements of the Minor in ME. If any of the outlined courses are used to satisfy another degree program, those courses may be replaced by any other course found on the program sheet, provided that the course is only used to fulfill the requirements of this Minor.
reviewNotes: The audit checks one of the three minors (General, Thermosciences or Mechanical Design), each course with a C or better. Checked by hand: the 2.7 combined GPA, and that no course also counts toward another degree program; if a listed course already counts for your major, replace it with another course from the program sheet and move it in. ME majors cannot add the Mechanical Design minor.
